newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Louis Dreyfus sees less orange juice volatility.
newsitem.headline: Louis Dreyfus sees less orange juice volatility.

text.p: Louis Dreyfus Citrus SA, the world's third-largest orange juice producer, expects price volatility to recede as the importance of weather in Florida declines from traditional levels, an official said.
The official, who asked not to be named, said that production in Florida has shifted further south since the 1980s, reducing the crop's vulnerability to freezing weather.
Growers were also using early-maturing varieties of oranges that are harvested before cold weather arrives.
"And over time, Brazil has actually overtaken Florida in overall production, so the world market is less vulnerable to the weather in Florida," he added.
"Production in Brazil has been very, very consistent, so in that way we would expect less volatility in price in the future," he said. --Zurich newsroom +41 1 631 7340
